decisions.description: Commercial controls default false, mandatory foundations/servicing true, no live authority can be supplied by public booleans; root fixture explicitly publishes synthetic approvals.

Quarantine reviewAt records review due and never auto-lifts hazardous operation denial. Recovery requires a dedicated incident-scoped rule replacement with remediation reference, separate approval grant; generic rollback cannot change quarantine.

ControlContext is an internal server contract. Scope values and reservation/commitment references must be derived and validated from authorized persisted records by the owning use case; flags never grant object/property authority.

Rule edits replace active snapshot entries but retain all immutable prior versions. The shared epoch lock serializes application commit and approval. Historical reads reuse the same SQL client to avoid pool acquisition deadlocks.

review_findings.finding: Nested database pool use inside rollback transactions could exhaust the20-connection process pool.
review_findings.resolution: Historical lookup/candidate methods now use the held SqlClient.

review_findings.finding: Generic rollback could otherwise lift a newly imposed security quarantine.
review_findings.resolution: Reject rollback if security-rule snapshot differs; require dedicated incident/remediation proposal.

review_findings.finding: Rejected foundation changes would lose audit if logged in the aborted transaction.
review_findings.resolution: Persist only sanitized operation/error code in a separate post-rollback audit, preserving original error on audit failure.

review_findings.finding: Package lock alone cannot enforce all platform workers, servicing operations, recipient properties or true resource-derived scope.
review_findings.resolution: Root must integrate guarded transactions and safe-money exception handling; full leaf remains in_progress.

review_findings.finding: An active quarantine could have been moved to a narrower scope or future start while still enabled, silently releasing existing coverage without recovery evidence.
review_findings.resolution: Existing active quarantine keeps incident, scope, effectiveFrom, dependencies, rollout and regional evidence until an explicit remediation-backed disable is independently approved; added three regression substitutions.
